_comment: Chance that each scout survives reaching a wave, per front. Report tiers by surviving scouts: sizeError / unitError are the relative width of the ranges reported (0 = exact). revealsStance: the report includes the wave's battle stance. Scouts can also search for ruins: `ruinSearch.minScouts` or more leave the village for `ruinSearch.hours` game hours, and when they are back they have found a forgotten ruin (a new ancient site within `ruinSearch.range` hexes of the village, on free ground that suits a kind of site, at least `ruinSearch.spacing` from other sites) with a chance of `chancePerScout` per scout, at most `maxChance`.
